title: Delhi Police arrest four over cryptocurrency phishing fraud on Binance P2P sellers
date_note: Both pages (24 November) report the arrests without giving the day they took place; the fraud on the complainant is dated 6 June by IANS.
org: Delhi Police (Cyber Police Station, South-West District)
geo_basis: city of the investigating police station (Delhi); victim's location not stated
summary: Delhi Police said they arrested four men from a syndicate that allegedly targeted cryptocurrency sellers through fake peer-to-peer buyers and phishing links. IANS reports the complainant's wallet balance was drained on 6 June after a supposed buyer moved the talk to WhatsApp. Police said the amount had been refunded to the complainant and recovered Rs 1.62 lakh in cash; the investigation continues.
plain: Delhi Police say they arrested four men who allegedly tricked a crypto seller into a phishing link and emptied his wallet. Police say the money was refunded.
exec: Police say a phishing syndicate targeted crypto sellers on a P2P platform; four men are arrested and the investigation continues.

validation.note: Two news agencies, PTI (via Rediff) and IANS (via Prokerala), each state the arrests and the method, citing Delhi Police; no police release read. ANI, The Hindu and The420 answered 403 or a challenge page.
